title: Elderly Couple in Formal Attire, 1940s B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A clear black and white full-length snapshot capturing an elderly couple dressed in formal Sunday attire standing outside on a sunny sidewalk. The gentleman wears a pinstripe suit, patterned tie, and a light-colored Panama-style fedora. The woman wears an elegant light dress with a corsage pinned to her shoulder, white heels, glasses, and a decorative flower-covered hat. In the background, other attendees and a brick building with arched windows suggest a church or wedding gathering on June 28, 1947.
